name: rush-cloud
description: Hand Rush a task: an agent does the work in its own cloud computer and returns a pull request, a report, files or an answer, with a record of what it did.

interface.shortDescription: Hand a task to a cloud agent
interface.longDescription:
Rush runs an agent on a task in its own cloud computer, with a browser and a terminal, and hands back the result with proof: a pull request with checks, a report, files or an answer, plus every step the agent took.

Ask in plain language to fix a bug, review a pull request, write tests, investigate an incident or produce a report. Rush starts the work at once and keeps going while you do something else; check on it, reply to it, or stop it from the conversation.

A task can work on a connected GitHub repository or on none. It reaches only the accounts and repository you name.

Sign in with your Rush account. Runs use the model account you connected to Rush, or Rush's own models.
capabilities: Start a task on a cloud agent, with or without a GitHub repository
Wait for one or several tasks and read their answers
Read the files a task changed, with the diff
Download the files and reports a task produced
Reply to a running task, or stop it
Save reusable agents with standing instructions
Connect an account a task needs through a sign-in link you open yourself
defaultPrompt: Ask Rush to review my latest pull request and list what it would change
Have Rush write tests for the parser module in my repo and open a PR
Ask Rush to research our three biggest competitors' pricing and send back a report
